title: Evidence-grounding eval run record
description: What one agent run (or one route: Analyst -> Concierge -> Tank/Oracle) read, cited, concluded and cost. Scored by .github/scripts/evidence_eval.py. Deliberately has NO field that can hold excerpt or answer text: conclusions carry a hash, citations and source keys only.

case_id.description: Eval case this run answers. Operational runs use the reviewer-written case id for the alert.

model.description: Model id from the run log.

skills.description: skill slug -> repository commit of its .claude/commands file.

uri.description: Source key: the source.uri an item from this read would carry.

bundle.description: The run's outbound evidence bundle (findings/evidence/schema.json); required when mode=on.

material.description: A factual conclusion the verdict rests on.

keys.description: Source keys the conclusion rests on (the prose path's citations).

actions.description: Side effects the run took or requested (suppress, fp_verdict, aikido_full_scan, ...).

staged_bytes.description: agent -> bytes of its staged input, rendering included.

killed.description: Any run in the route hit the 1800 s guard.

withheld_ids_found.description: Withheld evidence ids whose excerpt was found in a receiver's workdir, reply or logs (runbook section 2b step 4).
